scope: Only Shanghai Municipal Council, its independently documented source ownership, independently retained western/courtyard context and the reviewed replacement boundary, the 76-entry directory and 320px beacon capacity increment. One browser and one page, with sequential auxiliary/directory/main-map documents. No replay of the existing 35-model asset matrix.
captureStabilityPolicy: After viewport changes, wait for DOM/canvas/MapLibre dimensions and UI geometry to agree across two rendered frames before fitting the camera. Wait for map and beacon readiness, finished city far/near loading and queues, all pending feature-state writes, actual owner macro visibility, completed vector corrections, then the same stable source/mesh fingerprint across two rendered frames. Any failed attempt must retain its failure record and cannot count as an accepted screenshot.

placementBinding.method: Full additional-placement record equals independent contract; compact runtime catalog geometry/bounds fields compare separately. Source limit and retained geometry belong to the authored placement contract; runtime vector clipping computes original-source minus reviewed replacement geometry.
